if self.custom.startDate is None:
		now = system.date.now()
		self.custom.endDate = now
		self.custom.startDate = system.date.addDays(system.date.midnight(now), -6)
	opts = oee.dashboard.getLineOptions(value)
	if self.custom.lineId is None and len(opts) > 0:
		self.custom.lineId = opts[0]['value']
	return opts

opts = oee.dashboard.getMachineOptions(value)
	ids = [o['value'] for o in opts]
	if self.custom.machineId not in ids:
		self.custom.machineId = ids[0] if len(ids) > 0 else None
	return opts
